        self.cap = []
        self.cost = []

import heapq
from collections import deque

INF = float('inf')


class Flow:

    def __init__(self, n):
        self.n = n
        self.to = []
        self.cap = []
        self.cst = []
        self.graph = [[] for _ in range(n)]

    def add(self, u, v, cap, cost):
        g = self.graph
        i = len(self.to)
        self.to.append(v); self.cap.append(cap); self.cst.append(cost)
        g[u].append(i)
        self.to.append(u); self.cap.append(0); self.cst.append(-cost)
        g[v].append(i + 1)
        return i

        to = self.to; cap = self.cap; cst = self.cst; graph = self.graph
        n = self.n
        pot = [0] * n
        total = 0
        cost_total = 0
        phases = 0
        dinic_phases = 0
        augs = 0
        while True:
            dist = [INF] * n
            dist[S] = 0
            h = [(0, S)]
            pop = heapq.heappop; push = heapq.heappush
            while h:
